title: Renewable Energy (Electricity) Amendment (Continuing the Energy Transition) Bill 2017
short_title: Renewable Energy (Electricity) Amendment (Continuing the Energy Transition) Bill 2017

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would extend annual increases in the large scale Renewable Energy Target beyond 2020, changing the statutory requirements for renewable electricity through to 2030.
It would replace the fixed requirement of 33,000 gigawatt hours for each year from 2021 to 2030 with a list of progressively higher annual requirements.
The proposed amendments would operate within the existing Renewable Energy (Electricity) Act 2000 and would begin on the day the bill receives Royal Assent.
changes: Section 40 would be amended to give effect to the new target schedule.
A rising annual list would replace the existing flat requirements for the specified decade.
The target's period of annual increases would be extended to 2030.
summary.affected: Renewable electricity generators would be affected.
